verses.text: Around then, Jesus walked through grain fields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, so they started picking heads of grain and eating.
The Pharisees saw them and said to Jesus, “Look, your disciples are doing what isn’t allowed on the Sabbath.”
He replied, “Haven’t you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
“He went into God’s house and ate the showbread—the bread set out before God. It wasn’t lawful for him or his companions to eat it; only the priests could.
“Or haven’t you read in the Law that priests in the temple break the Sabbath and are still innocent?
“I’m telling you, someone greater than the temple is here.
“If you understood what this means—‘I want mercy, not sacrifice’—you wouldn’t have condemned the innocent.
“The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
Jesus left there and went into their synagogue.
A man with a withered hand was there. They asked Jesus, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?” They wanted a reason to accuse him.
He said to them, “If one of you has a sheep that falls into a pit on the Sabbath, won’t you grab it and pull it out?
“A person is worth much more than a sheep. So it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” The man stretched it out, and it was restored, healthy like the other one.
But the Pharisees left and plotted how they could destroy Jesus.
Jesus knew what they were planning and withdrew from there. Huge crowds followed him, and he healed them all.
He warned them not to make him known,
so what God had spoken through Isaiah the prophet would come true:
“Look at my servant, whom I chose; my beloved, with whom I’m well pleased. I’ll put my Spirit on him, and he’ll announce justice to the nations.
“He won’t argue or shout. Nobody will hear his voice out in the streets.
“He won’t snap a bruised reed or put out a smoldering wick, until he leads justice to victory.
“The nations will put their hope in his name.”
Then people brought Jesus a man possessed by a demon who was blind and couldn’t speak. Jesus healed him, and the man could both speak and see.
All the crowds were amazed. “Could this be the Son of David?” they asked.
When the Pharisees heard, they said, “This man drives out demons only by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.”
Jesus knew their thoughts and told them, “Every kingdom fighting itself ends up ruined. No city or household split against itself will stand.
“If Satan drives out Satan, he’s fighting himself. How can his kingdom stand?
“If I drive out demons by Beelzebul, who gives your own sons authority to drive them out? They’ll be your judges.
“But if I drive out demons by God’s Spirit, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
“How can anyone enter a strong man’s house and loot his goods without tying him up first? Then they can plunder his house.
“Anyone who isn’t with me is against me; anyone who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
“So I’m telling you: every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit won’t be forgiven.
“Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit won’t be forgiven, in this age or the age to come.
“Make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree bad and its fruit bad—the tree is known by the fruit it produces.
“You brood of snakes! How can you, being evil, say anything good? The mouth speaks from whatever fills the heart.
“A good person brings good things out of their good treasure; an evil person brings evil things out of their evil treasure.
“I’m telling you, people will answer on judgment day for every careless word they speak.
“Your words will either show you’re in the right or condemn you.”
Then some scribes and Pharisees answered him, “Teacher, we want you to show us a sign.”
He replied, “An evil and adulterous generation keeps asking for a sign. No sign will be given except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
“Just as Jonah was in the huge fish’s belly for three days and three nights, the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.
“The people of Nineveh will stand up at judgment with this generation and condemn it. They turned back to God when Jonah preached, and someone greater than Jonah is here.
“The Queen of the South will rise at judgment with this generation and condemn it. She came from the ends of the earth to hear Solomon’s wisdom, and someone greater than Solomon is here.
“When an unclean spirit leaves someone, it wanders through dry places looking for rest but finds none.
“Then it says, ‘I’ll go back to my house—the place I left.’ When it returns, it finds the place empty, swept clean, and put in order.
“So it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself. They move in and live there. That person’s last state is worse than the first. That’s how it will be for this evil generation.”
While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak with him.
Someone told him, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking to speak with you.”
He answered the person who told him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
He pointed toward his disciples and said, “Look—my mother and brothers!
“Anyone who does what my Father in heaven wants is my brother, sister, and mother.”
